assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and all three key area boundaries are provisional constraint polygons derived from announcement text and rough positioning.
assumptions.impact: All spatial calculations, areas, ratios, and geometry-derived metrics are approximate; replace with official polygons and recompute the full chain when available. Organizer data gaps do not block content scoring.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height limits, density, green ratio, and setbacks are unknown (planning_limits.json marks them missing).
assumptions.impact: All building scale and intensity content is conceptual; floor_area_ratio and total_floor_area_sqm are unknown in metrics.json.

assumptions.statement: Jing-Zhang Railway heritage protection zone boundaries are unknown; the schematic heritage corridor in constraints.geojson is an existing-condition placeholder.
assumptions.impact: Design near the heritage corridor and the Dazhongsi cultural cluster is directional only and subject to heritage review.

assumptions.statement: Land ownership and parcel boundaries are unknown.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish classifications and renewal projects are methodological suggestions, not parcel-level conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Underground utilities, pipeline capacities, and energy loads are unknown.
assumptions.impact: Utility-tunnel, distributed-energy, and edge-compute proposals are conceptual frameworks requiring professional assessment.
